body:
Follow-up to `radar-clutter-twin`: asks whether a more robust CFAR detector survives a Gaussian-clutter radar twin.

- New project `research/cfar-family-twin` (7 tests, results.txt, whitepaper, README).
- Finding: CA, OS and log-t all inflate 8–44× at design 1e-4 under gamma texture; a known-scale oracle inflates about as much as CA (the test cell's own texture); CA detects best after repair. No interfering targets modelled (stated as a limitation).
- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
